summary: Phase 5 final QA of 'Where Nature Leads' (client-side WebGL/Three.js game) executed headless via Playwright against the public preview URL. 26 of 26 acceptance items verified in code + at runtime; all three endings resolve to the expected kind, save/continue round-trips exactly, corrupt localStorage recovers cleanly, silence-mood class binding + cleanup works, all 16 settings testids are present and live-apply + persist across reload, autosave tick fires within 200ms and fades, choice-UI keyboard shortcuts 1/2/3 map to take/leave/share (map is correctly blocked during the choice), stuck-player respawn works from both out-of-bounds and below-terrain positions, pointer-lock loss auto-pauses the game, opening cinematic + HUD forwarding is correct, and the production build succeeds with the expected gzipped sizes (231.09 kB JS / 12.44 kB CSS). Zero console errors observed across the entire suite.

integration_issues.issue: Playwright reports pause-menu wrapper intercepting pointer events on pause-resume-btn in this specific headless-only path (immediately after callbacks.onPointerLockChange(false)). force=True click succeeds. Not reproducible when the pause menu is opened via Esc keydown in the same session, so this is most likely a headless overlay-stacking timing artifact, not a live bug. Worth flagging so main agent can visually confirm in a real Chrome window.

Once during 3 consecutive attempts the click on map-close-btn timed out while the button was reported visible+stable — same headless overlay-stack signature as above; force=True clears it. First close via Escape and the pause-menu Map path close cleanly.

headless_limitations_explicit: AUDIO OUTPUT cannot be heard from a headless browser — only the WebAudio graph state was inspected. Verified: audio.isInitialized()=true, ctx.state='running', masterGain/musicGain/sfxGain/ambientGain all created and connected, wind bus > 0, insect bus > 0, musicMode='exploration', area='The Entrance', quality→low correctly halves rain draw range and disables shadowMap. Real-audio timbre / footstep-per-area filtering was NOT ear-verified.

Cinematic time accumulation is throttled in headless (as noted in the request). The tests use window.__wnl.cinematic._t = 1.6 + window.__wnl.cinematic.stop() as directed — this is what the client's own hooks are for; no timing flakiness observed once used.
Pointer-lock behavior: real-hardware mouse behavior cannot be simulated. Used window.__wnl.callbacks.onPointerLockChange(false) as directed; auto-pause fired correctly.

One-time overlay-stacking flakes on map-close-btn and pause-resume-btn observed only in Playwright's actionability check; both resolved with force=True. Very likely a Chromium-headless z-index/timing artifact — the DOM was correct, the elements were visible+enabled+stable, but Playwright's overlay-intercept precheck rejected the click once each. Recommend main agent visually confirm in real Chrome.

rca_of_the_issue: No functional bugs found. Two documented headless-only interceptor flakes on map-close-btn (once) and pause-resume-btn (once, immediately after simulated pointer-lock loss). In both cases Playwright's actionability report said the target was visible+enabled+stable but the intercept check preferred the parent overlay div. Both cleared with force=True. Likely cause is a very brief overlay-fade-in transition where the child button hasn't yet 'won' the compositor pointer target ordering in headless Chromium. No user-facing impact expected in real desktop Chrome; main agent should visually re-verify. Two testing-side false alarms were self-corrected during the run: (1) reading Master slider via .value='40' fails because the slider range is 0..1 (value clamps to 1.0) — real UI drags produce a normalized value and the setBusVolume path is wired correctly to audio.setMasterGain → masterGain.gain.setTargetAtTime; (2) settings key for Interaction Hints is 'showHints' not 'hints' — the toggle is correctly wired in Menus.jsx line 199.
